basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of progressive metal and rock music, often found at concerts or music festivals. Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I work as a software developer with a penchant for tinkering with drones on weekends. My evenings are usually spent either listening to vinyl records or catching NBA games. Married with two kids, I balance family life with my love for music and technology. Typically online during late evenings after the kids are asleep.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a deep understanding of progressive music genres, developed over years of attending concerts and engaging with online communities. Holds a degree in Computer Science, which has facilitated a career in software development, further fostering an interest in drones and other tech gadgets.
